Fallback What the inverter does on its own when no plan holds. If the plan expires, or no fresh plan arrives for 3.0 h, the inverter returns to its native settings and keeps at least 20 % state of charge. Native settings Version 1, captured 8 Nov 2026, 19:40 by demo seed (Entered) Devices and data Work mode Self use Backup state of charge 25 % Grid charging Not allowed Time slots None (one mode all day) Edge device The small computer on site that receives signed plans and reads the inverter back. No edge device: plans are delivered as daily slot tables. Without an edge device the read-back is inferred from the site's behaviour; the installer keys each day's table and marks it applied. The site's public key (Ed25519, key ca41268f) o83GLGm2H/NlAQQOcPkJTY5JQ09Fq9QKhZ8gvIrqHCQ= The edge device checks every plan message against this key.
